Pinned interval

The selected procedure stays pinned while you switch witness sizes, making its runtime distribution and recurrence metadata directly comparable.

Intervals are observed, not reconstructed. Bar geometry is the unscaled start/end position from the measured trial nearest the Type-7 median trial time. Tooltip and table values are independent per-interval medians, so a bar’s width can differ from its P50. Semantic rows are overlapping views, not additive parts.

Clean headline scaling

A separate coordinated graph for Albert’s four requested measures. Time and heap use logarithmic vertical scales; proof size is linear. Move across any lane to compare one exponent, or click it to select the matching interval trace above.

Memory is a scalar high-water mark, not an interval. Peak tracked heap is the maximum outstanding Rust allocation bytes during one separate prove, with the live commitment hint included. It is not RSS and cannot be placed honestly on the wall-clock timeline.
